}}'''Matoun''' is a [[Saldaean]] lancer under the command of [[Davram Bashere]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Matoun}}

== Activities ==
He is one of the Saldaeans to accompany Bashere and [[Rand al'Thor]] to Rand's meeting with the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]]. During this meeting it is revealed that the supposed Daughter of the Nine Moons is actually [[Semirhage]] in disguise. After a fight ensues, he is asked to secure the area by Bashere.
